record.title: Interim Report of the AI Strategic Council and AI Institutional Study Group
record.short_title: AI Institutional Study Group Interim Report (2025)
record.issuing_body: AI Strategic Council; AI Institutional Study Group
record.summary: Interim report of the AI Strategic Council and its AI Institutional Study Group on Japan's AI regime, aiming to promote innovation while responding to risks. It relies mainly on existing laws plus guidelines and recommends a statutory basis for a stronger government command function and an AI strategy (basic plan); government guidelines in line with the Hiroshima AI Process for transparency and appropriateness across the AI lifecycle; promotion of safety evaluation and certification; government fact-finding on serious incidents with guidance and advice to businesses; and AI-specific procurement guidelines. Risks to life and safety and systemic risks stay with sector ministries for now.
record.notes: The AI Institutional Study Group was set up in July 2024 under the AI Strategic Council, which sits under the Integrated Innovation Strategy Promotion Council chaired by the Chief Cabinet Secretary with all ministers as members. It met seven times, heard 15 researchers, businesses and others, and held a public comment before the report. The report asks that the government's guidelines and fact-finding rest on law so that businesses, including foreign ones, can be asked to cooperate, and leaves national security risks such as CBRN development and cyberattacks to the ministries concerned. The Act on Promotion of Research and Development, and Utilization of AI-related Technology (Act No. 53 of 2025) followed in 2025.

english_version.by: AI Strategic Council / AI Institutional Study Group (provisional translation on the Cabinet Office site)

verification.note: Stored: the Japanese report (25 pages) and its English provisional translation ('Please refer to the original text for accuracy'), both from the Cabinet Office site (www8.cao.go.jp), dated 4 February 2025 and signed by the AI Strategic Council / AI Institutional Study Group. They confirm the title, the date, the bodies, their set-up, the process and the content; the summary is written from the Japanese text. The sentence on the AI Promotion Act rests on record JP-04, not on this candidate's stored files.

judgment.status_reasoning: A published advisory report with recommendations to the government ('期待する'); it binds no one. It is an interim report, and no final report is stored; it stays current as a published report.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A report of a government-convened council and study group on the design of Japan's AI risk governance: in scope as a government-commissioned report with no note.
judgment.title_reasoning: The Japanese cover says only 中間とりまとめ (Interim Report) with the bodies' names; the English title adds the bodies, as the provisional translation's cover does ('Interim Report ... AI Strategic Council / AI Institutional Study Group').
